explication: email2phonenumber is a single-file OSINT command-line tool with three documented modes: scrape recovery flows for masked phone digits, generate candidate numbers from numbering-plan data, and brute-force candidates against recovery flows to correlate masked emails. The README documents the modes and supported services; sampled excerpts show HTTP interactions with Amazon, Twitter, LastPass, PayPal, and numbering-plan data sources. The excerpts are partial, so internal dispatch and some integrations are represented only where documentation supports them.
